jcr:title: Stryker announces definitive agreement to acquire Invuity, Inc.

text.text:
Stryker (NYSE: SYK) announced today a definitive agreement to acquire all the issued and outstanding shares of common stock of Invuity, Inc. (NASDAQ: IVTY) for $7.40 per share, or a total equity value of approximately $190 million. Invuity is the leader in advanced photonics and single-use, lighted instruments that deliver enhanced visualization for a wide variety of clinical applications including orthopaedic and spine surgery, general surgery, and women's health procedures, and is a recent entrant into the enhanced energy market. Founded in 2004, and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Invuity's portfolio of innovative products is highly complementary to the Surgical portfolio of Stryker's Instruments business.
